primary_sources.title: SEC Release 34-99306
primary_sources.supports: One order dated 10 January 2024 approved eleven exchange rule-change proposals to list and trade Bitcoin-based trust shares or units.

primary_sources.title: SEC chair approval statement
primary_sources.supports: Listing and trading approval was not endorsement of Bitcoin; the court vacated the Grayscale rejection and remanded it to the Commission.

primary_sources.title: Winklevoss Bitcoin Trust Form S-1
primary_sources.supports: Registration statement filed 1 July 2013. This was a filing, not a rejection on that date.

primary_sources.title: SEC Release 34-80206
primary_sources.supports: Winklevoss exchange rule-change disapproval dated 10 March 2017.

primary_sources.title: SEC Release 34-87267
primary_sources.supports: Bitwise exchange rule-change disapproval dated 9 October 2019.

primary_sources.title: SEC Release 34-95180
primary_sources.supports: Grayscale exchange rule-change disapproval dated 29 June 2022.

primary_sources.title: BlackRock issuer release hosted by Nasdaq
primary_sources.supports: IBIT began trading on Nasdaq on 11 January 2024. Does not establish that all eleven proposals began spot trading that day.

artwork_interpretation: The mountain of papers, HODL and scene are fictional editorial metaphors, not evidence of a real photographed event. The geography is an anime-stylized interpretation of the reference view.
callback_correction: Parent review confirmed the bottle appears in card 021, while the returning HODL character also links card 055. Final clue text preserves this distinction.
limits: No assertion that all eleven proposals launched spot trading on 11 January. No price prediction, regulatory endorsement or final artwork legal-clearance claim.
